overview: Bay Lake Tower is a Disney Vacation Club tower next to the Contemporary, linked by a skybridge. It shares the Contemporary's restaurants and monorail, with a short walk to Magic Kingdom.
suits: Families who want villa space within walking distance of Magic Kingdom.
rooms:
As a Disney Vacation Club resort, rooms range from studios with a kitchenette to multi-bedroom villas with a full kitchen and washer and dryer. You don't need to be a member to stay; you can book with cash like a regular hotel.

Magic Kingdom-view villas have some of the best fireworks views on property.
pools: Bay Lake Tower has its own pool with a waterslide, and guests can also use the Contemporary's pools.
dining: Guests use the Contemporary's restaurants next door, including California Grill and Chef Mickey's.
cons: No restaurant in the tower itself
tips: Book a Magic Kingdom-view villa for fireworks from your balcony.
Walk the path to Magic Kingdom instead of waiting for the monorail.
bestFor: Families who want villa space close to Magic Kingdom.
